fee_notes: Standard Franchise Fee is $55,000 for one Protected Territory with approximately 20,000 persons aged 65+. Fee reduced by $2.75 per person for territories with fewer than 20,000 qualifying persons (minimum territory: 10,000 persons). Additional Protected Territories purchased simultaneously receive a 20% discount applied to the smaller territory. VetFran program provides a 20% discount for qualified U.S. Armed Forces veterans. In 2025, the range of initial franchise fees actually paid was $12,048 to $220,500. Fee is nonrefundable.
raw_excerpt: You must pay an initial Franchise Fee when you sign the Franchise Agreement. The Franchise Fee is $55,000 for one Protected Territory which will include approximately 20,000 persons who are age 65 or over (Items 11 and 12), as of the date of the Franchise Agreement. In 2025, the range of initial franchise fees paid was $12,048 to $220,500.
